<function name="Finish" parent="undo" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Completes an undo entry, and registers it with the player's client</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
        <file line="329-L363">lua/includes/modules/undo.lua</file>
        <args>
		<arg name="NiceText" type="string" default="nil">Text that appears in the player's undo history. If unset, is set to undo's name.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>This example creates a prop_physics, and adds it to the players undo list.</description>
	<code>
local prop = ents.Create( "prop_physics" )
prop:SetModel( "models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl" )
prop:Spawn()

undo.Create( "prop" )
	undo.AddEntity( prop )
	undo.SetPlayer( Player )
undo.Finish( "Prop (" .. prop:GetModel() .. ")" )
	</code>

</example>
